answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities at the task wharf. Each identity burns $30 to claim one work slot, locked 20 epochs; a falcon audit team spot-checks 5% of tasks, and any slot whose work fails is burned with its deposit. A raven watchlist flags identities whose timing moves in lockstep, catching clones that pass alone. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 for a $3,000 pool, while an honest agent burns $30 once and keeps its share.
